A '''repulsor coil''' or '''lift coil'''<ref name="SG">{{JournalCite|6|Swoop Gangs}}</ref> was an integral component in the building of a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engine. The repulsor coil was the component that produced the anti-[[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] field. The repulsor coil used a radioactive outburst to excite the electrons on the ground, disrupting the polarized magnetic thereby manipulating gravity. The effect of this gravity manipulation can be modified a great deal. Repulsor technology can therefore be utilized in everything from [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] to door systems.

In racing vehicles, like [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]], [[Speeder truck/Legends|speeder trucks]], and [[Hoversled/Legends|hoversleds]], repulsor coils were used to bolster the vehicle's repulsorlift engine and keep the vehicle at altitude while at low speeds.<ref name="EV" /> Repulsor coils were an important product of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] whose repulsor coils were exported to help in the construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]].
